bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "4b06a39ebdb8a99d5544b27c8a52f33ad8e42440"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
rid="run_mwyk50r3_a94e384027"
for endpoint in ("status","inspect"):
 o=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/"+endpoint+"/"+rid,timeout=5))
 run=o.get("run",o)
 print(endpoint.upper()+" "+json.dumps({k:run.get(k) for k in ("run_id","id","state","status","phase","stage","role","updated_at") if k in run}))
 print(endpoint.upper()+"_KEYS "+json.dumps(sorted(o.keys())))
 for k in ("role_results","roles","work_items","stages","steps","progress","continuation","diagnosis","analysis","candidate","strict_completion"):
  v=o.get(k,run.get(k))
  if isinstance(v,dict):
   print(k.upper()+" "+json.dumps({a:b for a,b in v.items() if a in ("state","status","role","phase","stage","completed","completed_roles","pending_roles","active_role","next_role") and isinstance(b,(str,int,bool,list))}))
  elif isinstance(v,list):
   print(k.upper()+"_COUNT="+str(len(v)))
PY
test "$(stat -c %a server/tests/server-command-tool-runtime.test.cjs)" = 644
curl -fsS -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8787/health
printf 'HEALTH_AND_HOST_MODE=PASS\n'
